question.worked_solution:
First, we recall the results for the derivatives of the basic reciprocal hyperbolic functions:

$$
(\operatorname{sech}⁡x)^{′}=-\operatorname{sech}⁡x\operatorname{tanh}⁡x,\,(\operatorname{csch}⁡x)^{′}=-\operatorname{csch}⁡x\operatorname{coth}⁡x,\,(\operatorname{coth}⁡x)^{′}=-{csch}^{2}⁡x
$$

Differentiating the given function using these results, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{sech}⁡x-2\operatorname{csch}⁡x) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{sech}⁡x)-2\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{csch}⁡x) \\  & =-\operatorname{sech}⁡x\operatorname{tanh}⁡x-2(-\operatorname{csch}⁡x\operatorname{coth}⁡x) \\  & =-\operatorname{sech}⁡x\operatorname{tanh}⁡x+2\operatorname{csch}⁡x\operatorname{coth}⁡x.\end{aligned}
$$
